verdict.rationale: Cline is a native IDE extension for VS Code, JetBrains, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, and Neovim (via ACP), providing in-editor chat with diffs, plan/act modes, and human-in-the-loop review of edits — this is corroborated by community reports of daily-driving Cline inside editors. missing for 10: no independent hands-on review specifically praising the chat UX/latency inside the IDE panel itself (community comments focus more on agentic quality than the chat UI).
